name: DescribeCustomEventAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The keywords that are used to search for the event.

- If you need to query the custom event whose content contains a and b, set the value to a and b.

- If you need to query the custom event whose content contains a or b, set the value to a or b
parameters.help_zh:
搜索事件内容包含的关键字。

- 如果您待搜索事件的内容中包括A和B，则可以搜索A和B。
- 如果您待搜索事件的内容中包括A或B，则可以搜索A或B
parameters.name: search_keywords

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间。

格式为Unix时间戳，即从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。

格式为Unix时间戳，即从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size
